note: Round 2 of #323, from the /no-comments pass flags. A fresh owner finished an interrupted owner's saved work (the pass's comment deletions plus an unfinished patch). (a) Outcome.parse takes the comparator's stdout and stderr apart (Streams) and reads the verdict from stderr's last line, so it no longer rests on run joining stderr last; runComparator uses the new Util.runOutput. parse_eq_ok_iff and parse_ok keep their propositions; only out's type changes from String to Streams, whose toList is the text run used to return. (b) gate/outcome-test.sh checks that every kernel the toolchain's Lake can run is in Outcome.kernels, and a #guard checks that the gate's comparator configurations set neither external_kernels nor enable_nanoda; removing con-ron fails the test, adding enable_nanoda fails the build. (c) Report.names takes a Quote and adds ': ' or ' ' itself. (d) revLines and linesBefore become linesFromLast. (e) parse_stdout (any exit code) and pluginFailure_stdout prove that stdout can only choose between importClash and noJudgment, which pluginFailure sends to one gate. New theorems use propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound at most. Round-1 mutant (reports on every line) and a joined-last-line mutant fail the build. Cheats print_kernel_reject, print_illegal_axiom, print_missing_const, missing_obligation and fake_axiom: 10 runs as expected. CI at c556802 (an updater rebase of 7c9370a): gate and checks green, outcome-test.sh 4 passed. CodeRabbit's one finding (outcome-test.sh ignored a failed comm, so the check could pass open) is fixed: a failed comm counts as missing kernels, and a bundledKernels entry whose name is not read fails the test; three broken inputs (a new entry on two lines, a new entry on one line, a failing comm) each fail it, and the real source passes. tokens not metered; wall_min approximate.
